subject: Money
title: Universal Basic Income
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Universal Basic Income.

hook.text: Alaska gives every resident about $1,600 per year from oil revenue. No application. No means test. Everyone gets it.

buildup.text: UBI provides a floor. Nobody falls below it. Proponents say it reduces poverty without welfare bureaucracy.

discovery.text: Stockton, California tested UBI with $500 monthly. Recipients got jobs at double the rate of the control group.

twist.text: Funding UBI for 330 million Americans at $1,000/month costs $4 trillion annually—the entire federal budget.

climax.text: UBI addresses inequality at the bottom but doesn't touch concentration at the top. It treats symptoms, not causes.

punchline.text: A floor for everyone. A ceiling for no one.

quiz.question: What happened in Stockton's UBI experiment?
options: Recipients got jobs at double the rate of the control group
